glossary.definition: Death resulting solely and directly from accident caused by violent, accidental, external and visible means within twelve calendar months.
Wholly and continuously disable and prevent the Insured from performing every duty pertaining to his profession or occupation.
Continuously disable and prevent the Insured from performing an important daily duty pertaining to his profession or occupation.
An act including the use of force or violence for political, religious, ideological or similar purposes including the intention to influence any government.
